name: Pressmark
description: Create and preview PDF invoices, estimates, receipts, contracts, non-disclosure agreements, and real estate documents from the details you provide. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).
starter_prompts: Create an invoice for 15 hours of consulting at $250 per hour.
Convert my $5,000 design estimate to an invoice due in 30 days.
Create a receipt for a payment I already received.
